The Premium amount as advance shall be paid in two steps for Rs. 20 crores each of Sum Ins ured Value. Second instalments of the Premium amount will be released only after the exhaustio n of the previous premium amount already paid. 10. Airports Authority of India reserves the right to cancel or accept any or all the bids whatso ever to any of the bidders. 11. The bidder should submit flat rate of premium in the financial bid. 12. All the related tenders shall liable to be cancelled, if more than one bid is received from th e same or parent company. No two or more concerns/agencies/firms in which an individual is inte rested, as Proprietor and/or partner shall tender for this work. If they do so, all such bids shall be liable to be rejected. 13. summarily rejected. 14. All information and documents provided by the Agencies / firms shall remain the property of AAI. 15. Submission of a tender by a bidder implies that he has read this notice and all other contra ct documents and has made himself aware of the scope of works to be done and the conditions o f area and other factors bearing on the successful completion of the contract. 16. Per Bottom Limit & Per Location Limit is Rs.20,00,00,000/- (Rupees Twenty Crore only). To increase Limit per transit /Limit per location, Insurance Company will be informed before dispatc h. 17. Each consignment will be booked for Insurance, on the basis of supplier’s Invoice value, und er the Open Cover before dispatch of the shipment and the Insurance Company has to issue a Pol icy for each consignment separately, which should be valid for a period of one year from the date of issue, and the premium amount shall be adjusted against the Advance already paid. 18. The Insurance Policy has to be issued within 24 hours after the request made by AAI. 19. The insurance should not be hampered due to the consignment is booked on different date, but consigned on a single date by the Liner due to any reason. 20. AAI reserve the right to Debar/Black list the bidder in case the bidder backs out after emerging successful (L-1) in the bid or fails to execute the work as per Work Or der. 21. The premium + tax on the unutilized balance of sum insured value shall be refundable to Ai rports Authority of India at the end of the year/expiry of contract and not later than 30 (thirty) da ys after the expiry of the contract. 22. The excess clause in the Policy- Asset amount Deductible 1% Of claim and subject to m Claim up to 2 Crores inimum of INR 1000 1% of claim and subject to mi Claim 2 - 5 Crores nimum of INR 5000 1% of claim and minimum of Claim above 5 Crores 10000 23. Basis of valuation for claim should be CIF + 10% for each consignment.
